decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The large screen hereby approved is for a temporary period only and shall be removed on or before 12 July 2026.

Reason: The type of structure is not such as the local planning authority is prepared to approve, other than for a limited period, in view of its appearance. The permanent retention of the structure would be contrary to the requirements of policy D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

HW_SE_P_LP, HW_SE_P_01, HW_SE_P_02, HW_SE_P_03, cover letter dated 19/12/2026, Design, access and operational statement dated 19/02/2026, Noise impact assessment ref. 25091297 dated 29/01/2026, Even management plan dated 19/02/2026, Metropolitan Police Operational Support & Events Handover form dated 05/02/2026, Premises Licence dated 19/12/2024

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The large screen and seating area hereby approved shall be operated at all times in accordance with the Event Management Plan dated 19 February 2026 and Noise impact assessment ref. 25091297 dated 29/01/2026. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - The use of the screen and screening events shall only take place during the following hours: 10:00-20:00 Monday-Sunday.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
subdivision_of_building: Central area of the Market Square
description: Installation of temporary grassed seating area and large screen on podium for Summer Garden and Wimbledon Championships screening installation.
